name: calendar.list
description: List single events. Dates are ISO timestamps with offsets.

name: calendar.freebusy
description: Check overlap, optionally excluding the event being edited.

name: calendar.create
description: Create a single, non-recurring local event if conflict-free.

name: calendar.update
description: Update permitted fields; scenario policy limits this to evt-review start/end. Checks current App version and conflicts.

name: calendar.cancel
description: Cancel a local event. Does not send invitations.

name: calendar.export_ics
description: Export one event as iCalendar text.

name: calendar.attachment.add
description: Attach validated file bytes to a calendar event.

name: calendar.attachment.remove
description: Remove an attachment reference from this record.

name: calendar.import_ics
description: Import one VEVENT with UTC DTSTART/DTEND, UID and SEQUENCE. Unsupported properties are rejected rather than dropped.

name: calendar.attachment.get
description: Read an attachment on this record through parent-scoped authorization.
